bridge_dit_storage_objects_20261114
statements:
-- Actual OCI object evidence for each DIT source file and its Primary/Recovery copies.
-- Browser clients receive only short-lived signed PUT URLs; evidence writes are server-only.
create table if not exists public.bridge_dit_storage_objects (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  session_id uuid not null,
  relative_path text not null,
  copy_type text not null check (copy_type in ('PRIMARY', 'RECOVERY')),
  bucket_name text not null check (length(trim(bucket_name)) > 0),
  object_key text not null check (length(trim(object_key)) > 0),
  sha256 char(64) not null check (sha256 ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  byte_size bigint not null check (byte_size >= 0),
  etag text,
  status text not null default 'UPLOAD_PENDING'
    check (status in ('UPLOAD_PENDING', 'VERIFIED', 'FAILED')),
  verified_at timestamptz,
  created_by text not null references public.bridge_profiles(user_id) on delete restrict,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  foreign key (session_id, relative_path)
    references public.bridge_dit_ingest_files(session_id, relative_path)
    on delete cascade,
  unique (session_id, relative_path, copy_type),
  unique (bucket_name, object_key),
  check ((status = 'VERIFIED') = (verified_at is not null and etag is not null))
);

create index if not exists bridge_dit_storage_objects_session_status_idx
  on public.bridge_dit_storage_objects (session_id, status, copy_type);

create index if not exists bridge_dit_storage_objects_bucket_key_idx
  on public.bridge_dit_storage_objects (bucket_name, object_key);

alter table public.bridge_dit_storage_objects enable row level security;
alter table public.bridge_dit_storage_objects force row level security;
revoke all privileges on table public.bridge_dit_storage_objects from public, anon, authenticated;

records.name: bridge_production_schedule_20261118
statements:
-- Organization-scoped Studio production calendar.
-- Access is through verified server actions; browser roles receive no direct table privileges.
create table if not exists public.bridge_production_schedule_events (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  organization_id uuid not null references public.bridge_organizations(id) on delete restrict,
  title_id text not null references public.bridge_titles(id) on delete restrict,
  event_type text not null check (
    event_type in ('PRE_PRODUCTION', 'SHOOT_DAY', 'WRAP', 'DIT_HANDOFF', 'POST_PRODUCTION', 'DELIVERY', 'OTHER')
  ),
  event_name text not null check (length(trim(event_name)) between 1 and 180),
  starts_at timestamptz not null,
  ends_at timestamptz not null,
  location text,
  notes text,
  status text not null default 'SCHEDULED' check (
    status in ('SCHEDULED', 'IN_PROGRESS', 'COMPLETED', 'CANCELLED')
  ),
  created_by text not null references public.bridge_profiles(user_id) on delete restrict,
  updated_by text not null references public.bridge_profiles(user_id) on delete restrict,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  check (ends_at > starts_at),
  check (location is null or length(location) <= 240),
  check (notes is null or length(notes) <= 4000)
);
create index if not exists bridge_production_schedule_org_start_idx
  on public.bridge_production_schedule_events (organization_id, starts_at);
create index if not exists bridge_production_schedule_title_start_idx
  on public.bridge_production_schedule_events (title_id, starts_at);
alter table public.bridge_production_schedule_events enable row level security;
alter table public.bridge_production_schedule_events force row level security;
revoke all privileges on table public.bridge_production_schedule_events from public, anon, authenticated;

records.name: bridge_studio_invites_and_owner_transfer_20261118
statements:
-- Studio-specific invitation acceptance and dual-control ownership transfer.
-- Server actions perform all writes; client roles have no direct table access.
create table if not exists public.bridge_studio_invites (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  organization_id uuid not null references public.bridge_organizations(id) on delete restrict,
  email text not null check (length(trim(email)) between 3 and 320),
  membership_role text not null check (membership_role in ('admin', 'producer', 'dit', 'member')),
  invited_by text not null references public.bridge_profiles(user_id) on delete restrict,
  token_hash char(64) not null unique check (token_hash ~ '^[a-f0-9]{64}$'),
  expires_at timestamptz not null,
  accepted_by text references public.bridge_profiles(user_id) on delete restrict,
  accepted_at timestamptz,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  check ((accepted_at is null) = (accepted_by is null)),
  check (accepted_at is null or revoked_at is null)
);
create unique index if not exists bridge_studio_invites_pending_email_idx
  on public.bridge_studio_invites (organization_id, lower(trim(email)))
  where accepted_at is null and revoked_at is null;

create index if not exists bridge_studio_invites_org_created_idx
  on public.bridge_studio_invites (organization_id, created_at desc);

alter table public.bridge_studio_invites enable row level security;
alter table public.bridge_studio_invites force row level security;
revoke all privileges on table public.bridge_studio_invites from public, anon, authenticated;

create table if not exists public.bridge_studio_ownership_transfers (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  organization_id uuid not null references public.bridge_organizations(id) on delete restrict,
  current_owner_user_id text not null references public.bridge_profiles(user_id) on delete restrict,
  proposed_owner_user_id text not null references public.bridge_profiles(user_id) on delete restrict,
  status text not null default 'PENDING' check (status in ('PENDING', 'ACCEPTED', 'CANCELLED')),
  reason text not null check (length(trim(reason)) between 8 and 1000),
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  accepted_at timestamptz,
  cancelled_at timestamptz,
  check (current_owner_user_id <> proposed_owner_user_id),
  check ((status = 'ACCEPTED') = (accepted_at is not null)),
  check ((status = 'CANCELLED') = (cancelled_at is not null))
);

create unique index if not exists bridge_studio_ownership_transfer_pending_org_idx
  on public.bridge_studio_ownership_transfers (organization_id)
  where status = 'PENDING';

create index if not exists bridge_studio_ownership_transfer_target_idx
  on public.bridge_studio_ownership_transfers (proposed_owner_user_id, status, created_at desc);

alter table public.bridge_studio_ownership_transfers enable row level security;
alter table public.bridge_studio_ownership_transfers force row level security;
revoke all privileges on table public.bridge_studio_ownership_transfers from public, anon, authenticated;

records.name: bridge_creator_document_vault_20261118
statements:
-- Canonical Supabase migration for the private Creator/Studio legal-evidence vault.
-- Evidence files remain in private OCI storage; this table stores verified object keys only.
-- Client roles receive no table privileges. Access is mediated by trusted server workflows.

create table if not exists public.bridge_creator_documents (
  id text primary key,
  owner_user_id text not null references public.bridge_profiles(user_id) on delete restrict,
  owner_account_type text not null check (owner_account_type in ('independent_creator', 'studio')),
  owner_organization_id text,
  document_type text not null check (document_type in (
    'FINISHED_FILM_AGREEMENT',
    'STORY_CONCEPT_AGREEMENT',
    'DISTRIBUTION_AGREEMENT',
    'OWNERSHIP_CHAIN_OF_TITLE',
    'AUTHOR_ASSIGNMENT',
    'MUSIC_RIGHTS',
    'OTHER'
  )),
  file_name text not null,
  content_type text not null,
  byte_size bigint,
  storage_key text not null unique,
  status text not null default 'PENDING_UPLOAD'
    check (status in ('PENDING_UPLOAD', 'VERIFIED', 'REVOKED')),
  created_by text not null references public.bridge_profiles(user_id) on delete restrict,
  verified_at timestamptz,
  revoked_at timestamptz,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  check (
    (owner_account_type = 'independent_creator' and owner_organization_id is null)
    or owner_account_type = 'studio'
  )
);

create index if not exists bridge_creator_documents_owner_idx
  on public.bridge_creator_documents(owner_user_id, created_at desc);
create index if not exists bridge_creator_documents_org_idx
  on public.bridge_creator_documents(owner_organization_id, created_at desc)
  where owner_organization_id is not null;

create table if not exists public.bridge_title_document_links (
  id text primary key,
  title_id text not null references public.bridge_titles(id) on delete cascade,
  document_id text not null references public.bridge_creator_documents(id) on delete restrict,
  evidence_type text not null check (evidence_type in (
    'FINISHED_FILM_AGREEMENT',
    'STORY_CONCEPT_AGREEMENT',
    'DISTRIBUTION_AGREEMENT',
    'OWNERSHIP_CHAIN_OF_TITLE',
    'AUTHOR_ASSIGNMENT',
    'MUSIC_RIGHTS',
    'OTHER'
  )),
  linked_by text not null references public.bridge_profiles(user_id) on delete restrict,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  unique(title_id, document_id, evidence_type)
);

create index if not exists bridge_title_document_links_title_idx
  on public.bridge_title_document_links(title_id, created_at desc);

alter table public.bridge_creator_documents enable row level security;
alter table public.bridge_title_document_links enable row level security;

revoke all on table public.bridge_creator_documents from public, anon, authenticated;
revoke all on table public.bridge_title_document_links from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select, insert, update on table public.bridge_creator_documents to service_role;
grant select, insert, update on table public.bridge_title_document_links to service_role;

records.name: bridge_exclusive_sublicensing_authority_20261119
statements:
-- Bridge-exclusive sublicensing decisions.
-- No Creator, Studio, Buyer or Loop identity receives rights-management privileges.
create table if not exists public.bridge_sublicense_authorizations (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  title_id text not null references public.bridge_titles(id) on delete restrict,
  rights_grant_id uuid not null references public.bridge_rights_grants(id) on delete restrict,
  downstream_licensee text not null check (length(trim(downstream_licensee)) between 2 and 200),
  downstream_licensee_reference text not null check (length(trim(downstream_licensee_reference)) between 2 and 500),
  territories jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(territories) = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(territories) > 0),
  languages jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(languages) = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(languages) > 0),
  media jsonb not null check (jsonb_typeof(media) = 'array' and jsonb_array_length(media) > 0),
  window_start timestamptz not null,
  window_end timestamptz not null,
  restrictions jsonb not null default '[]'::jsonb check (jsonb_typeof(restrictions) = 'array'),
  evidence_document_id text not null references public.bridge_creator_documents(id) on delete restrict,
  status text not null default 'AUTHORIZED' check (status in ('AUTHORIZED','SUSPENDED','REVOKED','EXPIRED')),
  created_by text not null,
  created_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  updated_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  check (window_end > window_start)
);
create index if not exists bridge_sublicense_authorizations_title_idx
  on public.bridge_sublicense_authorizations(title_id, created_at desc);
create index if not exists bridge_sublicense_authorizations_grant_idx
  on public.bridge_sublicense_authorizations(rights_grant_id, status);
alter table public.bridge_sublicense_authorizations enable row level security;
revoke all on table public.bridge_sublicense_authorizations from anon, authenticated;
grant all on table public.bridge_sublicense_authorizations to service_role;

create unique index if not exists bridge_sublicense_authorizations_idempotency_idx
  on public.bridge_sublicense_authorizations(rights_grant_id, downstream_licensee_reference, window_start, window_end);

records.name: 20261120110000_bridge_story_concept_rights_review_workflow
statements:
alter table public.bridge_story_concept_submissions
  add column if not exists rights_holder_name text,
  add column if not exists rights_basis text,
  add column if not exists third_party_materials_included boolean,
  add column if not exists rights_declaration_accepted_at timestamptz,
  add column if not exists rights_declaration_version text,
  add column if not exists editorial_status text not null default 'PENDING',
  add column if not exists editorial_reviewed_by text,
  add column if not exists editorial_reviewed_at timestamptz,
  add column if not exists editorial_review_notes text,
  add column if not exists legal_status text not null default 'PENDING',
  add column if not exists legal_reviewed_by text,
  add column if not exists legal_reviewed_at timestamptz,
  add column if not exists legal_review_notes text;

alter table public.bridge_story_concept_submissions
  add constraint bridge_story_concept_rights_basis_check
    check (rights_basis is null or rights_basis in ('ORIGINAL_AUTHOR', 'ASSIGNED', 'LICENSED', 'PUBLIC_DOMAIN', 'OTHER')),
  add constraint bridge_story_concept_editorial_status_check
    check (editorial_status in ('PENDING', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'NEEDS_INFO')),
  add constraint bridge_story_concept_legal_status_check
    check (legal_status in ('PENDING', 'UNDER_REVIEW', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED', 'NEEDS_INFO'));

create index if not exists bridge_story_concept_editorial_queue_idx
  on public.bridge_story_concept_submissions (editorial_status, created_at);
create index if not exists bridge_story_concept_legal_queue_idx
  on public.bridge_story_concept_submissions (legal_status, created_at);

comment on column public.bridge_story_concept_submissions.rights_holder_name is
  'Declared rights holder; declaration is a claim and is not legal verification.';
comment on column public.bridge_story_concept_submissions.rights_declaration_accepted_at is
  'Timestamp of the submitter accepting the versioned rights declaration.';
comment on column public.bridge_story_concept_submissions.editorial_status is
  'Independent editorial assessment; does not grant rights or authorize publication.';
comment on column public.bridge_story_concept_submissions.legal_status is
  'Independent legal assessment; approval does not itself publish or license a title.';

records.name: malayalakkara_conditional_submission_test_only
statements:
create table if not exists public.bridge_conditional_submissions (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  title_id text not null references public.bridge_titles(id) on delete restrict,
  submission_kind text not null check (submission_kind = 'CONDITIONAL_LEGAL_VERIFICATION'),
  status text not null default 'PENDING_LEGAL_VERIFICATION'
    check (status = 'PENDING_LEGAL_VERIFICATION'),
  submitted_by uuid not null,
  submitted_at timestamptz not null default now(),
  metadata jsonb not null default '{}'::jsonb,
  constraint bridge_conditional_submissions_malayalakkara_only
    check (title_id = '858f0ec5a11bc9acd2e9c20266541a3a'),
  constraint bridge_conditional_submissions_one_time_per_title
    unique (title_id, submission_kind)
);
alter table public.bridge_conditional_submissions enable row level security;
revoke all on table public.bridge_conditional_submissions from public, anon, authenticated;
grant select, insert on table public.bridge_conditional_submissions to service_role;
